name: Pawel Kwiecien
headline: Software Engineer at Meta
summary:
Full stack developer, passionate about working on innovative ideas. Extensive technical
knowledge and a good sense of product and user experience. Supportive and enthusiastic team player.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: I've been working on various products at Meta, such Facebook Analytics, Marketplace and Commerce, Shops Ads and Business AI.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Worked on Microsoft Flow (https://flow.microsoft.com), a product that enables customers to automate tasks. 

Focusing on the developer experience in Microsoft Flow:
• contributed to a generic editor for integrating external Services and APIs into the product, 
• worked on co-authoring experience,
• developed an SDK for embedding the editing experience in PowerApps

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Joined the Office organization and worked on the Approval scenario, one of the core
features for a new approval workflow platform. Additionally, designed the architecture of an experimental and innovative iOS app for creating collaborative databases. Implemented major functionality such as editable grid and the networking layer.

In December 2015 moved Power BI team to work on the leading data visualization and analytics tools, focusing on platform extensibility:
• implemented open source JavaScript SDK for rendering interactive reports, 
• worked on Publish To Web feature for embedding reports in external websites (see https://powerbi.microsoft.com/en-us/publishtoweb).

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Worked at the department of Software Engineering for Business Information Systems supporting research and industrial projects such as IT mergers and acquisitions.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Early employee of a Venture Capital backed startup in Munich: a simulation platform for mechanical engineers.
Implemented various features from ground up: reporting tool for generating simulation reports, an administration panel for managing accounts

positions.title: Software Quality Assurance
positions.description: Worked at the Quality Assurance Department, testing various software components, a web application, applications for mobile devices and a database server

company.name: Meta
company.description:
Meta's mission is to build the future of human connection and the technology that makes it possible. 

Our technologies help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology.
